questions.subject: en
questions.question: What initially made the river readings difficult to compare?
questions.answer: The teams sampled in different seasons.
options: The teams sampled in different seasons.
Both laboratories used a shared timetable from the start.
Both teams measured the same samples together.
questions.explanation: Seasonal differences complicate a direct comparison.
questions.passage: Monitoring teams on two sides of a border reported different average readings for river pollution. One team sampled during the rainy season, while the other sampled in the dry season. The governments agreed to adopt a shared timetable and laboratory protocol. Neither government endorsed a finding about the source of the pollution.
